sentence: Daily turtle: buy when the close breaks above the highest high of the previous 55 days, sell when it falls below the lowest low of the previous 20 days. 15% stop.
On 30 minute candles buy when RSI 7 crosses above 25 and sell when RSI 7 crosses below 75. Stop at 4%.
4 hour chart, golden cross: buy when the 12 period EMA crosses above the 26 period EMA, sell when it crosses back below. Stop at 8%.
Daily Bollinger band mean reversion: buy when the close drops below the lower band (20, 2), sell when it reaches the middle band. 10% stop.
MACD on 1h: buy when the MACD line crosses above its signal line, sell when it crosses below. 6% stop.
15 minute scalper: buy when stochastic K crosses above 20 and RSI 14 is below 40; sell when stochastic K goes above 80. 3% stop, take 2% profit.
Weekly trend follower: buy when the close is above the 10 week simple average, sell when below it. Stop 25%.
Daily: buy when ADX 14 is above 25 and rising and the close is above the 50-day EMA; sell when the close falls below the 20-day lowest low. 15% stop with a 5% trailing stop.
Hourly breakout with volatility: buy when the close is above the 24 hour high from the previous candle and ATR 14 is rising; sell below the 24 hour average. 7% stop.
Daily triple EMA: buy when price crosses above TEMA 30, sell when it crosses below. 12% stop loss.
